root.name: Scotch Game: Scotch Gambit
root.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Bc4

overview: White develops the bishop instead of recapturing on d4, offering the d-pawn for quick development. Black can play 4...Bc5 or 4...Nf6; after 4...Nf6 5.e5 d5 6.Bb5 Ne4 7.Nxd4 White regains the pawn with an open game. Against 4...Bc5 White plays 5.c3 or 5.O-O and Black has the chance to keep the pawn, so play is active and tactical with pressure on f7.

white_ideas.idea: Develop fast with c3, O-O and aim at f7 with Bc4 and Ng5.
Break open the centre with e5 and Nxd4 to regain the pawn with a lead in development.

black_ideas.idea: Develop with ...Bc5 and ...Nf6 and hit the e4 pawn.
Return the pawn at the right moment with ...d5 to reach an equal open game.

typical_structures.structure: Open centre with Black pawn on d4 until White recaptures, then symmetrical open lines.

character.notes: Open tactical game with early forcing play and attacks on f7. Sharp.

gambit.notes: After 4...Bc5 5.c3 Black can keep the d4 pawn, but 4...Nf6 5.e5 d5 returns it by force. Gambit by name; the 4...Bc5 5.c3 dxc3 line is what keeps it a gambit.

soundness.notes: Sound, roughly equal with best play.

structure.notes: Open from the start, like the Scotch.

approach.notes: Played by strong players now and then; standard.

level.notes: Needs known lines after 4...Bc5 and 4...Nf6 5.e5, but not long forcing tabiyas. Intermediate.

sublines_that_differ.name: Advance Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Bc4 Nf6 5. e5
sublines_that_differ.how: Often transposes to the Two Knights 4.d4 line with a quick equal open game.

sublines_that_differ.name: Sarratt Variation
sublines_that_differ.moves: 1. e4 e5 2. Nf3 Nc6 3. d4 exd4 4. Bc4 Bc5 5. Ng5

character.reason: Open, forcing play with attacks on f7.

gambit.reason: White offers the d-pawn, though it often returns by force in the main lines.

structure.reason: Pawns come off at once and the game turns on open lines.

approach.reason: Used by strong players as an alternative to the main Scotch.

level.reason: Some theory but clear piece play.

plans.reason: White trades a pawn for time and aims at f7.
